neighbors.establishing_passage: CNN predicts FEV1 and FVC from low-dose CT; 'mean absolute error and CCC were 0.22 L and 0.94, respectively, for FVC'; RSNA search summary indicates Grad-CAM/averaged saliency only (central lung fields weighted), no causal concept test.

'CAV is originally a model interpretability technique which the researchers adopted to identify convolution layers responsible for learning race and only fine-tune up to that layer... to reduce racial disparities while preserving the performance of the targeted task' — concept-direction removal in medical imaging, for fairness, not Pi10.
DL-estimated inspiratory fSAD 'was associated with FEV1 (adj.beta = -0.034, P < 0.001)... and FEV1 decline' in SPIROMICS — associational airway-vs-FEV1 DL work, no model decoding.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2406.06512 (Nature 2026 DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10181-8 seen in search results only)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 3D vision-language model trained on volumetric CT, EHR, and reports, evaluated on 752 tasks including '5-year chronic disease prediction (6 diseases)'; abstract mentions no interpretability or renal sinus fat.

Latent Shift counterfactuals extended to 3D CT classifiers, applied to lung-size regression and a pleural effusion classifier ('bright regions along the lung periphery'); no kidney, CKD, or renal sinus fat anywhere in the text.

'KV (OR = 0.249...) and PrFT... were identified as independent predictors of CKD'; 'Fat in the renal hilum was segmented using a semi-automated approach based on HU thresholding' — correlational CT-fat-to-CKD evidence, no model audit.

'Whole-brain T1c and T2 images ... cropped or padded to a final 3D array of shape 130 x 130 x 130' (extracranial tissue retained); 'Model explainability was further pursued using a guided backpropagation approach'; temporalis/muscle/extracranial appear only in related-work discussion, no substitution experiment.

'CSA was an independently significant predictor for survival in both the in-house and TCGA-GBM data sets'; authors 'first to show that a head/neck muscle-derived sarcopenia metric generated using deep learning is associated with oncological outcomes' — association, not model reliance.

'Models trained on binarized images preserved performance... volumetric features — particularly brain contours introduced through skull-stripping — were consistently used' — shortcut audit in Alzheimer's via preprocessing configs + LRP; no region substitution, no temporalis, no tumor model.

'The study examined the correlation of 512 Mirai features with mammographic observations... Mirai implicitly learned to identify mammographic lesion features, particularly calcifications, for lesion detection and risk prediction' (CalcMirai AUC 0.66 vs Mirai 0.66 in screen-negatives).

'A polar grid ... centered on the nipple, was then overlaid on the mammographic image', fitted 'to an approximation of the ductal distribution extending from the nipple posteriorly... in a radial fashion' — nipple-relative radial texture coordinates as prior art.

'Gabor filters are used to detect and localise architectural distortion by analysing the oriented texture in mammograms, with a bank of Gabor filters obtaining the orientation field' — orientation-field CAD, not model auditing.

S(H)NAP 'constructs generative interventional attributions... leveraging realistic 3D diffusion bridge modeling to systematically modify anatomical features [to] isolate object-specific causal contributions to the risk score'; intervenes on nodules/lobes/artifacts; states 'Sybil likely infers age from global cues like bone density'; vertebrae/marrow NOT among intervened objects.
Sybil predicts 'individual risk without requiring additional demographic or clinical data'; 1-year AUCs 0.86-0.94 across NLST/MGH/CGMH; no interpretability analysis at source.

'Increased CV (per 10% increment) of both the L1 vertebrae (OR 1.859...) and L2 vertebrae (OR 2.045...) were associated with increased odds of OVF' — intra-vertebral attenuation heterogeneity as an image signature, for fracture, not smoking/LDCT/Sybil.

Automated 3D quadratic diaphragm modeling 'measured multiple parameters including shape index, principal curvatures, height, and surface area'; 'several parameters were correlated with the PFT parameters.'

neighbors.identifier: PMID 39090324; PMC11294507 (Bakker et al., Eur Radiol Exp 2024)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Diaphragm index 'progressively decreased with worsening COPD severity across GOLD stages' and 'correlated significantly with lung function measurements (FEV1% predicted, r = 0.44)', segmented 'based on the lung-diaphragm intersection rather than direct diaphragm segmentation.' Candidate card cites 'Bak'; verified first author is Bakker.
'The interpretability of the model's prediction process was analyzed using the Grad-CAM visualization technique' — DL CT-to-PFT model (FEV1 r=0.84) with saliency only; diaphragm not localized.

'Deep learning-extracted bilateral dissimilarity produced similar risk scores to those of Mirai (1-year risk, r = 0.6832; 4-5-year, r = 0.6988)... Localized bilateral dissimilarity... approximated the predictive power of Mirai and was a key to Mirai's reasoning'; mirroring the unilateral breast made Mirai predict uniformly low risk. DUPLICATE for C7's deliverable claim.
'A simplified model using only calcification features achieved comparable risk prediction performance to the original Mirai model in a screen-negative population.'

neighbors.identifier: PMID 24200481; DOI 10.1016/j.acra.2013.08.020; PMC3856115 (Tan, Zheng et al., Acad Radiol 2013)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'This investigation developed a support vector machine model using bilateral mammographic asymmetry features to stratify cancer risk in women following negative screening examinations' (AUC ~0.725). Do not conflate with the related PMID 24725671 cited in the candidate card.
'A deep learning model analyzing post-radiotherapy MRI images can accurately predict eight-month survival in glioblastoma patients' — T2 + contrast-T1 branches, 11 UK centers, 206 patients.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 34853344; DOI 10.1038/s41598-021-02495-6 (Curtin et al., Sci Rep 2021 — candidate card misattributes to 'Tate')
neighbors.establishing_passage: '...the shape of T2/FLAIR abnormalities that are typically associated with edema showing the strongest relationship with overall survival'; lower lacunarity and higher fractal dimension in edema correlated with improved survival.

'Box counting method with the preprocessing steps namely binarization, dilation and outlining was used to obtain the fractal dimension and lacunarity in glioma' — the box-counting + lacunarity toolchain on glioma MR.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2207.10384 (published: DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-39902-7, PMID 37463884 — search_summary; PubMed CAPTCHA-blocked)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Shortcut testing (ST) via multitask learning, 'the first method to assess and mitigate shortcut learning as a part of the fairness assessment of clinical ML systems,' demonstrated on radiology and dermatology — no pixel-preserving edits, no CT-CLIP.

neighbors.identifier: PMID 32043947; DOI 10.1148/radiol.2020191621 (van Velzen et al., Radiology 2020;295(1):66-79)
neighbors.establishing_passage: 'The algorithm consists of two convolutional neural networks: the first CNN detects candidate calcifications and labels them by anatomic location, while the second CNN detects true calcified voxels' — reference automated CAC/TAC scoring across six CT protocols; no confound analysis.

CT-CLIP is 'a CT-focused contrastive language-image pretraining framework... [that] outperforms state-of-the-art fully supervised models across all key metrics in multi-abnormality detection'; limitations note dataset biases but no shortcut audit of any abnormality output.
